Game Overview

Destroy The Circle is a ball game built around guide your nimble yellow circle to eliminate numbered blue targets in a strategic test of precision. Decrease each target's count while evading collisions. This vibrant arcade challenge demands skillful navigation and sharp timing to masterfully clear every level. One mistake could mean game over!
